def fact(n: int) -> bigint:
    """Factorial of n as an arbitrary-precision integer."""
    pre n >= 0
    post out >= bigint(1)
    ex fact(0) == bigint(1)
    ex fact(5) == bigint(120)
    ex fact(20) == bigint(2432902008176640000)
    ex fact(25) == fact(24) * bigint(25)
    acc = bigint(1)
    for i in range(2, n + 1):
        acc = acc * bigint(i)
    return acc
